newsitem.title: USA: LA broker Boston Group suspends trading.
newsitem.headline: LA broker Boston Group suspends trading.

text.p: Penny stock brokerage firm Boston Group LP suspended trading Thursday because its capital fell below minimum requirements.

Vice chairman Kye Hellmers said the firm's capital base declined this week as shares of companies in which it holds large positions tumbled. He attributed part of these losses to allegedly illegal short selling on the part of traders.
"We believe part of the signficant decline in the value of these securities is due to short selling and some may have been illegal," Hellmers said.

"We ceased market-making action yesterday in about 50 securities and are hopeful we can recommence operations next week through an infusion of capital or a business combination with another entity," Hellmers said.
Hellmers said Chicago Pizza & Brewery Inc, Sound Source Interactive Inc and Jerry's Famous Deli were among the stocks that tumbled this week.
Boston Group is the market maker for these companies.
